primary_title: Cryo-EM structure of the active, Gs-protein complexed, human CGRP receptor
decision_basis: The endogenous CGRP peptide is resolved in the active human CALCRL-RAMP1 receptor complex with Gs by cryo-EM, defining ligand-complex binding and activation-compatible receptor architecture
limitations_preserved: Promote the CGRP-CALCRL/RAMP1 receptor-complex assembly/activation layer; preserve RCP/Gs and peptide-processing context, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Structure and Dynamics of Adrenomedullin Receptors AM1 and AM2 Reveal Key Mechanisms in the Control of Receptor Phenotype by Receptor Activity-Modifying Proteins
decision_basis: Adrenomedullin is resolved in the active human CALCRL-RAMP2 receptor complex with Gs by cryo-EM, defining RAMP2-dependent ligand recognition and receptor activation architecture
limitations_preserved: Promote the ADM-CALCRL/RAMP2 receptor-complex assembly/activation layer; preserve RAMP2-dependent AM1 topology and Gs/RCP context, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
